general.description: Every configured MCP server, no shell. What you get with no profiles file at all.

repository.description: Work in a checked-out project and its history. Reads freely; every git command that writes — commit, rebase, merge, push, reset, clean, checkout, rm, branch -D, stash drop — stops for a person first. Plans with todos, and drops old command output once the conversation gets long.
repository.system_prompt: You are working inside a git repository. Read before you write, and say plainly when you cannot verify something rather than assuming it.

analysis.description: Read data files and summarise them. Reading only — computing over them needs an interpreter, which this deliberately does not have.
analysis.system_prompt: You are examining data. State the shape and provenance of what you read before drawing conclusions from it.

research.description: Search and read. Deliberately no shell — that pair is the injection path 0.2.0 removed.
research.system_prompt: You are researching. Cite what you read, and say plainly when a source does not answer the question.
